Created by artist, cosmetic historian and designer Gabriela Hernandez, Bésame Cosmetics is a vintage makeup brand that honors the style, spirit, and sensibility of female beauty. Long Lasting and Water Resistant

Also an Eyeliner and Eyebrow Fill

Vegan and Sustainably Made

How to make out normal style?

1. make out normal style

5. start with the 1/3 top of the eyelash,1/3 partly-brush cream, 1/3 partly-brush silk fiber,after 3 seconds, 1/3 partly-brush cream

7. repeat to twist the eyelash like twist tread, then go on brushing; try more times and find out the correct way
8. Other ladies can do it, you can do it too! Trust yourself
Note: eyelash should be dry completely before twisting

3. Brush the third time, start with the 1/3 top of the eyelash, 1/3 partly-brush cream, 1/3 partly-brush silk fiber, after 3 seconds, 1/3 partly-brush cream.

Note: Only the first time, start with the bottom, 3/3 fully-brush, after then, all will be 1/3 partly-brush


How To Make Out Super-long Style?

1. Follow the instructions to make out normal style first

2. Then use tweezers to stick 3 eyelashes together, and wait them to be dry

3. After eyelash dry completely, twist the 3 eyelash like twist tread

5. Start with the 1/3 top of the eyelash, 1/3 partly-brush cream, 1/3 partly-brush silk fiber,after 3 seconds, 1/3 partly-brush cream

6. Repeat silk fiber and cream, all 1/3 partly-brush, up and down

7. Repeat to twist the eyelash like twist tread, then go on brushing, Try more times and find out the correct way

Note: Eyelash should be dry completely before twisting

Before using it, please read below methods and steps carefully.

It requires skills and practice. Other ladies can do it well, you can too. Once you are skilled, you will feel it is really so good and so magical. We appreciate if you can share this good item with your sisters and friends.

How to make out normal style?

1. Brush the first time, start with the bottom of the eyelash, 3/3 fully-brush cream, 3/3 fully-brush silk fiber,after 3 seconds, 3/3 fully-brush cream.
2. Brush the second time, start with the 1/3 top of the eyelash,1/3 partly-brush cream, 1/3 partly-brush silk fiber,after 3 seconds, 1/3 partly-brush cream.
3. Brush the third time, start with the 1/3 top of the eyelash, 1/3 partly-brush cream, 1/3 partly-brush silk fiber,after 3 seconds, 1/3 partly-brush cream.

Note: Only the first time, start with the bottom, 3/3 fully-brush； after then, all will be 1/3 partly-brush


How to make out super-long style?

1. make out normal style
2. then use tweezers to stick 3 eyelashes together, and wait them to be dry.
3. can brush a little silk fiber and make eyelash dry faster.
4. after eyelash dry completely, twist the 3 eyelash like twist tread.
5. start with the 1/3 top of the eyelash,1/3 partly-brush cream, 1/3 partly-brush silk fiber,after 3 seconds, 1/3 partly-brush cream.
6. repeat silk fiber and cream, all 1/3 partly-brush, up and down.
7. repeat to twist the eyelash like twist tread, then go on brushing; try more times and find out the correct way 8. Other ladies can do it, you can do it too! Trust yourself.

Note: eyelash should be dry completely before twisting.
Safe tips:
1. Please do not do it as any uses except makeup.
2. Please do not put under direct sunlight or too high or too low temperature.
3. Keep out of the reach from children.
4. Please test it before use, if have any abnormal situation, please stop using it.

description:
The queen Mascara and Eyeliner "2 in 1"
- Our top selling 2 in 1 pen.
- 4X thicker waterproof Mascara Liquid Eyeliner.
- Save your money


How to make out normal style?

1. Brush the first time, start with the bottom of the eyelash, 3/3 fully-brush cream, 3/3 fully-brush silk fiber,after 3 seconds, 3/3 fully-brush cream.
2. Brush the second time, start with the 1/3 top of the eyelash,1/3 partly-brush cream, 1/3 partly-brush silk fiber,after 3 seconds, 1/3 partly-brush cream.
3. Brush the third time, start with the 1/3 top of the eyelash, 1/3 partly-brush cream, 1/3 partly-brush silk fiber,after 3 seconds, 1/3 partly-brush cream.

Note: Only the first time, start with the bottom, 3/3 fully-brush； after then, all will be 1/3 partly-brush


How to make out super-long style?

1. make out normal style
2. then use tweezers to stick 3 eyelashes together, and wait them to be dry.
3. can brush a little silk fiber and make eyelash dry faster.
4. after eyelash dry completely, twist the 3 eyelash like twist tread.
5. start with the 1/3 top of the eyelash,1/3 partly-brush cream, 1/3 partly-brush silk fiber,after 3 seconds, 1/3 partly-brush cream.
6. repeat silk fiber and cream, all 1/3 partly-brush, up and down.
7. repeat to twist the eyelash like twist tread, then go on brushing; try more times and find out the correct way 8. Other ladies can do it, you can do it too! Trust yourself.

Note: eyelash should be dry completely before twisting.
Safe tips:
1. Please do not do it as any uses except makeup.
2. Please do not put under direct sunlight or too high or too low temperature.
3. Keep out of the reach from children.
4. Please test it before use, if have any abnormal situation, please stop using it.

1. Brush the first time, start with the bottom of the eyelash, 3/3 fully-brush cream, 3/3 fully-brush silk fiber,after 3 seconds, 3/3 fully-brush cream.

1. make out normal style

7. repeat to twist the eyelash like twist tread, then go on brushing; try more times and find out the correct way

Note: eyelash should be dry completely before twisting

Step 9: Remove the eye pads from under eye area. Use dampened cotton with cold water to remove the color until no residue. Mop the excess water near eyes with a piece of tissue.

How to make out a normal style?

1. Brush the first time, start with the bottom of the eyelash, 3/3 fully-brush cream, 3/3 fully-brush silk fiber, after 3 seconds, 3/3 fully-brush cream.

2. Brush the second time, start with the 1/3 top of the eyelash,1/3 partly-brush cream, 1/3 partly-brush silk fiber, after 3 seconds, 1/3 partly-brush cream.

3. Brush the third time, start with the 1/3 top of the eyelash, 1/3 partly-brush cream, 1/3 partly-brush silk fiber, after 3 seconds, 1/3 partly-brush cream.

Note: Only the first time, start with the bottom, 3/3 fully-brush； after then, all will be 1/3 partly-brush

How to make out a super-long style?

1. make out normal style

2. then use tweezers to stick 3 eyelashes together and wait for them to be dry

3. can brush a little silk fiber and make eyelash dry faster

4. after eyelash dry completely, twist the 3 eyelashes like twist tread

5. start with the 1/3 top of the eyelash,1/3 partly-brush cream, 1/3 partly-brush silk fiber, after 3 seconds, 1/3 partly-brush cream

6. repeat silk fiber and cream, all 1/3 partly-brush, up and down

7. repeat to twist the eyelash like twist tread, then go on brushing; try more times and find out the correct way 

Note: 

1. Use a good eye makeup remover.

A good waterproof eye makeup remover will remove all vestiges of mascara quickly, safely and effectively.

2. Remove your mascara with makeup remover oil. 

Oil breaks down the waterproof properties in your mascara, helping it slide off your lashes with minimal scrubbing and wiping.

description:
How to make out normal style?

1. Brush the first time, start with the bottom of the eyelash, 3/3 fully-brush cream, 3/3 fully-brush silk fiber,after 3 seconds, 3/3 fully-brush cream.

2. Brush the second time, start with the 1/3 top of the eyelash,1/3 partly-brush cream, 1/3 partly-brush silk fiber,after 3 seconds, 1/3 partly-brush cream.

3. Brush the third time, start with the 1/3 top of the eyelash, 1/3 partly-brush cream, 1/3 partly-brush silk fiber,after 3 seconds, 1/3 partly-brush cream.

Note: Only the first time, start with the bottom, 3/3 fully-brush； after then, all will be 1/3 partly-brush

How to make out super-long style?

1. make out normal style

2. then use tweezers to stick 3 eyelashes together, and wait them to be dry

3. can brush a little silk fiber and make eyelash dry faster

4. after eyelash dry completely, twist the 3 eyelash like twist tread

5. start with the 1/3 top of the eyelash,1/3 partly-brush cream, 1/3 partly-brush silk fiber,after 3 seconds, 1/3 partly-brush cream

6. repeat silk fiber and cream, all 1/3 partly-brush, up and down

7. repeat to twist the eyelash like twist tread, then go on brushing; try more times and find out the correct way 

Note: 

1. Use an good eye makeup remover.

A good waterproof eye makeup remover will remove all vestiges of mascara quickly, safely and effectively.

2. Remove your mascara with makeup remover oil. 

Oil breaks down the waterproof properties in your mascara, helping it slide off your lashes with minimal scrubbing and wiping.

description:
you will love our all natural, vegan and gluten free mascara. Our mascara is enriched with tons of lash nourishing ingredients including Chamomile, Vitamin E, Oregano, Thyme, Coffee Powder, Cinnamon, Rosemary and Grapefruit that condition and stimulate lash growth.

BENEFITS
Smudge proof, fade proof, run proof, and smear proof. Great for sensitive eyes and sensitive skin.
Volume builds with each coat-no clumps, no globs.

NON IRRITATING: Specially formulated for those with sensitive eyes, so you can get the lash look you want without frustration.
100% natural formula lengthens and defines lashes instantly for a beautiful look.

Follow tips:
For maximum impact, begin by combing your lashes, then create the look of extra long lashes using an eyelash curler.
Carefully align the eyelash curler with your lashes and hold for five to ten seconds.
Hold the wand in one hand, and with the other, gently lift the eyelid back so you have full leverage to coat the lashes from root to tip.
Pull the wand out of the tube and wipe any excess product against the opening of the container - you can always add more later on.
Apply mascara at the base of your lashes and sweep up through the ends, wiggling the wand from side to side. This will coat the sides of the lashes too.

Tips
1) Always replace your mascara every 3 months. This is the most hygienic replenishment time for all eye makeup products. Plus, it ensures your mascara never gets too dry.
2) Always let mascara set (but not dry!) between applications. Two coats of mascara should always be applied, but never more than that. Wait 10 seconds for formula to set before applying second coat so lashes won't clump.
3) Never apply before liner. Your fresh coats of mascara will smudge and clump together if you apply liner after mascara. Applying mascara before liner also prevents you from being able to get as close to the lash line as possible.

1. make out normal style

3. can brush a little silk fiber and make eyelash dry faster

5. start with the 1/3 top of the eyelash,1/3 partly-brush cream, 1/3 partly-brush silk fiber,after 3 seconds, 1/3 partly-brush cream
6. repeat silk fiber and cream, all 1/3 partly-brush, up and down
7. repeat to twist the eyelash like twist tread, then go on brushing; try more times and find out the correct way
8. Other ladies can do it, you can do it too! Trust yourself

description:
Blinc's Tubing Mascara is the original tube-technology mascara. It's invented to form tiny water-resistant "tubes" around your lashes for maximum amplification and hold, rather than painting them like conventional mascaras. Once applied, the tubes bind to your lashes and don't run, smudge, clump, or flake, even if you cry or rub your eyes. Better Than Waterproof Mascara﻿ When you're ready to take it off, the simple combination of lots of warm water and gentle pressure will slide the tiny tubes effortlessly off your lashes into your hand (no need for harsh makeup removers) . Upon removal, you will actually see the tiny tubes slide into your hand. Blinc's Tubing Mascara has been clinically tested to be non-irritating, making it ideal for sensitive eyes, contact lens wearers, and active people in search of a mascara whose look, hold, and ease of removal is without compromise. Now, after almost a decade in development, Blinc's AMPLIFIED tubing mascara provides incredible, buildable, glamorous volume and length, all while offering the same smudge-proof, sweat-proof, water-resistant, flake-proof properties of our original tubing mascara.

La máscara de tubo de Blinc's es la máscara original de tecnología de tubo. Se inventó para formar pequeños "tubos" resistentes al agua alrededor de tus pestañas para una máxima amplificación y sujeción, en lugar de pintarlos como mascaras convencionales. Una vez aplicado, los tubos se unen a las pestañas y no corren, mancha, se agrupan o se escamas incluso si lloras o te frotas los ojos. Mejor que el rimel impermeable Cuando estés listo para quitártelo, la simple combinación de mucha agua tibia y suave presión deslizará los tubos pequeños sin esfuerzo de tus pestañas en tu mano (sin necesidad de quitamaquillaje). Tras la extracción, verás que los pequeños tubos se deslizan en tu mano. La máscara de máscara de tubo de Blinc's ha sido clínicamente probada para no irritante, por lo que es ideal para ojos sensibles, usuarios de lentes de contacto y personas activas en busca de una máscara cuyo aspecto, agarre y facilidad de eliminación es sin compromisos. Ahora, después de casi una década en desarrollo, el rimel de tubos AMPLIFIED de Blinc proporciona un volumen y longitud increíbles, construibles y glamorosos, todo al tiempo que ofrece las mismas propiedades a prueba de manchas, a prueba de sudor, resistente al agua y a la escama de nuestra máscara de tubo original.

מסקרה של Blinc's Tubing היא המסקרה המקורית בטכנולוגיית צינור. הוא הומצא כדי ליצור "צינורות" זעירים עמידים במים סביב הריסים שלכם להגברה ואחיזה מקסימלית, במקום לצבוע אותם כמו מסקרה קונבנציונלית. לאחר ההדבקה, הצינורות נקשרים לריסים שלכם ולא רוצים, נמרחים, גושים או מתפוררים, גם אם אתם בוכים או משפשפים את העיניים. טוב יותר ממסקרה עמידה במים כאשר אתם מוכנים להוריד אותה, השילוב הפשוט של הרבה מים חמים ולחץ עדין יחליק את הצינורות הזעירים ללא מאמץ מהריסים שלכם לתוך היד שלכם (אין צורך במסיר איפור קשים). לאחר ההסרה, למעשה תראו את הצינורות הזעירים מחליקים לתוך היד שלכם. מסקרה Tubing של Blinc's נבדקה קלינית כלא מגרה, מה שהופך אותה לאידאלית לעיניים רגישות, עדשות מגע ואנשים פעילים שמחפשים מסקרה שהמראה, מחזיקים וקלות ההסרה שלהם ללא פשרות. עכשיו, אחרי כמעט עשור בפיתוח, מסקרה הצינורות המוגברים של Blinc's מספקת נפח ואורך מדהימים, ניתן לבנייה, זוהר, כל זאת תוך מתן את אותה עמידות למריחה, זיעה, עמידה במים, תכונות עמידות בפני קשקשים של מסקרה הצינורות המקורית שלנו.

Expert Tips

1) Always replace your mascara every 3 months. This is the most hygienic replenishment time for all eye makeup products. Plus, it ensures your mascara never gets too dry and clumpy.

 

2) Always let mascara set (but not dry!) between applications. Two coats of mascara should always be applied, but never more than that. Wait 10 seconds for formula to set before applying second coat so lashes won't clump.

 

3) Never apply before liner. Your fresh coats of mascara will smudge and clump together if you apply liner after mascara. Applying mascara before liner also prevents you from being able to get as close to the lash line as possible. Remember - liner first, then two coats of mascara!

Frilliance Perfecting Primer+Serum does some of the hard work in caring for acne-prone skin. This silky primer serum combo includes powerful acne-fighters like mandelic acid plus hydrating, skin-soothing ingredients like aloe. An ideal formulation to help stop breakouts, use this non-comedogenic primer serum under your makeup or as a soothing night treatment for your skin. Adios, acne. Hello, glow.

HOW TO APPLY:
Wash hands. Apply 1-2 pumps of primer serum on the back of your hand. One application is about the size of a nickel. Smooth gently over face with light, rubbing motion. For daytime use, let dry and apply makeup if you wish. KEY INGREDIENTS:
L-Mandelic Acid: Mandelic acid is a kinder, gentler alpha-hydroxy acid that is derived from bitter almonds. Though mandelic acid is powerful in accelerating the turnover of skin cells, it is much less irritating than many other alpha hydroxy acids.This leads to a brighter, smoother, more even complexion. Mandelic acid’s antibacterial properties are extremely helpful in treating acne keeping bad things out of your pores. It also helps to regulate sebum production and in turn, decrease the occurrence of breakouts.

Lactic Acid:Lactic acid is an alpha hydroxy acid (AHA) and derived from foods. Lactic acid helps your skin shed dead skin cells because it operates as a non-friction type of exfoliant---the power of a good scrub without the scrubbing! A great choice for sensitive skin, lactic acid is gentle yet powerful and helps rejuvenate your skin and brighten your complexion. Lactic acid helps the appearance of large pores making them appear smaller.
